q: 医生开的药我已经吃___了，咳嗽也好多了。
zh: 医生开的药我已经吃完了，咳嗽也好多了。
py: yī shēng kāi de yào wǒ yǐ jīng chī wán le ké sou yě hǎo duō le
en: I've already finished the medicine the doctor prescribed, and my cough is much better.
why: 吃完 says the course of medicine reached its end. 会 is for a skill you have learned, and 见 and 住 do not combine with 吃 to mean finished.

q: 天气预报说明天下雪，我们的厚衣服都准备___了。
zh: 天气预报说明天下雪，我们的厚衣服都准备好了。
py: tiān qì yù bào shuō míng tiān xià xuě wǒ men de hòu yī fu dōu zhǔn bèi hǎo le
en: The forecast says it will snow tomorrow, and our warm clothes are all ready.
why: 准备 normally takes 好 for ready and set. 懂 and 会 are about understanding and skills, and 到 would only mean reaching a goal, not being ready.

q: 我终于学___游泳了，夏天可以自己去海边玩了。
zh: 我终于学会游泳了，夏天可以自己去海边玩了。
py: wǒ zhōng yú xué huì yóu yǒng le xià tiān kě yǐ zì jǐ qù hǎi biān wán le
en: I've finally learned to swim, so this summer I can go to the beach by myself.
why: 学会 means you studied until you can do it, which is what lets you go alone. 见 and 住 do not mean learning, and 懂 is only understanding.

q: 医生让你吃___饭再吃这种药。
zh: 医生让你吃完饭再吃这种药。
py: yī shēng ràng nǐ chī wán fàn zài chī zhè zhǒng yào
en: The doctor says to take this medicine after you've finished eating.
why: 吃饭 is a verb-object word, so the result goes right after 吃: 吃完饭 means the meal has ended. 到, 见 and 懂 cannot say a meal is finished.

q: 医生说他腿上的伤还没长___，所以暂时不能去滑冰。
zh: 医生说他腿上的伤还没长好，所以暂时不能去滑冰。
py: yī shēng shuō tā tuǐ shàng de shāng hái méi zhǎng hǎo suǒ yǐ zàn shí bù néng qù huá bīng
en: The doctor says the wound on his leg hasn't healed properly yet, so he can't go skating for now.
why: 长好 (zhǎng hǎo) says the wound has healed properly and is usable again. 完 would say growth reached its end, and 会 and 懂 are about skills and understanding.

q: 夏天太热了，我跑了三家店才买___风扇。
zh: 夏天太热了，我跑了三家店才买到风扇。
py: xià tiān tài rè le wǒ pǎo le sān jiā diàn cái mǎi dào fēng shàn
en: It was so hot that summer I went to three shops before I managed to buy a fan.
why: 买到 says the buying succeeded and you got the item. 见 only goes with seeing and hearing, and 懂 and 会 are about understanding and skills.

q: 我找了半天，终于在包里找___体温计了。
zh: 我找了半天，终于在包里找到体温计了。
py: wǒ zhǎo le bàn tiān zhōng yú zài bāo lǐ zhǎo dào tǐ wēn jì le
en: I searched for ages and finally found the thermometer in my bag.
why: 找到 says the search reached its target. 找完 would only say you finished looking, and 懂 and 会 do not fit the verb 找.

q: 医生用了很多英文词，我一个也没听___。
zh: 医生用了很多英文词，我一个也没听懂。
py: yī shēng yòng le hěn duō yīng wén cí wǒ yī gè yě méi tīng dǒng
en: The doctor used lots of English words and I didn't understand a single one.
why: 懂 is the result for understanding what you hear. 见 and 到 only say the sound reached your ears, which the cue does not ask for, and 完 is about finishing.

q: 你昨天寄的体检报告，我今天上午已经收___了。
zh: 你昨天寄的体检报告，我今天上午已经收到了。
py: nǐ zuó tiān jì de tǐ jiǎn bào gào wǒ jīn tiān shàng wǔ yǐ jīng shōu dào le
en: I already received the medical report you sent yesterday this morning.
why: 收到 says the report reached you. 见 is limited to seeing and hearing and cannot follow 收, and 懂 and 会 would mean understanding and skill.

q: 他说得太快，虽然每个字我都听见了，但整句话没听___。
zh: 他说得太快，虽然每个字我都听见了，但整句话没听懂。
py: tā shuō de tài kuài suī rán měi gè zì wǒ dōu tīng jiàn le dàn zhěng jù huà méi tīng dǒng
en: He spoke so fast that although I heard every word, I didn't understand the whole sentence.
why: 但 sets up a contrast: every word was heard (听见) but the sentence was not understood (听懂). 到 and 见 would repeat heard, and 完 is about finishing.

q: 天气预报是中文的，我看了三遍还是没看___。
zh: 天气预报是中文的，我看了三遍还是没看懂。
py: tiān qì yù bào shì zhōng wén de wǒ kàn le sān biàn hái shi méi kàn dǒng
en: The weather forecast was in Chinese; I read it three times and still didn't understand it.
why: 看懂 is understanding what you read. 见 and 到 would mean you did not see it at all, which three readings contradict, and 完 would mean not finished.

q: 护士把我的名字写___了，应该是李，不是力。
zh: 护士把我的名字写错了，应该是李，不是力。
py: hù shi bǎ wǒ de míng zi xiě cuò le yīng gāi shì lǐ bú shì lì
en: The nurse wrote my name wrongly; it should be 李, not 力.
why: 错 right after 写 says the writing came out wrong, and the second half gives the correction. 对 would say it was written correctly, which contradicts 应该是…不是….

q: 旁边太吵了，医生的话我一个字也没听___，请他再说一遍。
zh: 旁边太吵了，医生的话我一个字也没听清楚，请他再说一遍。
py: páng biān tài chǎo le yī shēng de huà wǒ yī gè zì yě méi tīng qīng chu qǐng tā zài shuō yī biàn
en: It was so noisy next to me that I could not hear a word the doctor said clearly, so I asked him to say it again.
why: 听清楚 is the result for hearing distinctly, which noise ruins. 干净 means clean and 错 would mean misheard, and 完 would mean you did not reach the end.

q: 雪天路很脏，我把鞋擦___再进屋。
zh: 雪天路很脏，我把鞋擦干净再进屋。
py: xuě tiān lù hěn zāng wǒ bǎ xié cā gān jìng zài jìn wū
en: The road was dirty in the snow, so I wiped my shoes clean before going in.
why: 擦干净 says the wiping left the shoes clean, which suits dirty roads. 对 and 错 are about right and wrong, and 清楚 is for hearing and seeing clearly.

q: 你把吃药的次数记___了，应该是一天两次，不是三次。
zh: 你把吃药的次数记错了，应该是一天两次，不是三次。
py: nǐ bǎ chī yào de cì shù jì cuò le yīng gāi shì yī tiān liǎng cì bú shì sān cì
en: You got the number of doses wrong; it should be twice a day, not three times.
why: 记错 means remembered it wrongly, and the correction after 应该是 shows that. 记住 would mean successfully kept in mind, which the correction contradicts.

q: 他把体检表上的数字抄___了一个，结果医生也算错了。
zh: 他把体检表上的数字抄错了一个，结果医生也算错了。
py: tā bǎ tǐ jiǎn biǎo shàng de shù zì chāo cuò le yī gè jié guǒ yī shēng yě suàn cuò le
en: He copied one of the numbers on the medical form wrongly, so the doctor's calculation came out wrong too.
why: 抄错 says one number was copied wrongly, which explains why the calculation is wrong. 抄对 would say it was copied correctly, and 清楚 and 干净 do not describe a wrong number.

q: 这个电话号码很重要，请你一定要记___。
zh: 这个电话号码很重要，请你一定要记住。
py: zhè ge diàn huà hào mǎ hěn zhòng yào qǐng nǐ yí dìng yào jì zhù
en: This phone number is important, so please be sure to remember it.
why: 记住 means fix it in your memory so it stays. A bare 记 only says write down or note, 开 means open or apart, and 掉 and 走 mean gone and taken away.

q: 昨天太热了，我一晚上都没睡___。
zh: 昨天太热了，我一晚上都没睡着。
py: zuó tiān tài rè le wǒ yī wǎn shàng dōu méi shuì zháo
en: It was so hot yesterday that I couldn't fall asleep all night.
why: 睡着 (zháo) is the result for actually falling asleep, here negated with 没. 睡住 and 睡掉 do not exist, and 光 would mean no sleep was left.

q: 夏天太热了，请把窗户打___。
zh: 夏天太热了，请把窗户打开。
py: xià tiān tài rè le qǐng bǎ chuāng hu dǎ kāi
en: It's so hot in summer, please open the window.
why: 打开 means make something open, which is what you do to a window. 住 means held or stopped, 掉 means got rid of, and 光 means nothing left.

q: 感冒好了，这些没吃完的药可以扔___了。
zh: 感冒好了，这些没吃完的药可以扔掉了。
py: gǎn mào hǎo le zhè xiē méi chī wán de yào kě yǐ rēng diào le
en: Your cold is better, so you can throw away the medicine you didn't finish.
why: 扔掉 means throw away and get rid of. 走 means taken away by someone, 住 means held in place, and 开 means open or apart.

q: 有人把我放在门口的雨伞拿___了。
zh: 有人把我放在门口的雨伞拿走了。
py: yǒu rén bǎ wǒ fàng zài mén kǒu de yǔ sǎn ná zǒu le
en: Somebody took away the umbrella I left by the door.
why: 拿走 says someone took the thing away with them. 拿住 means hold on to it, and 光 would mean the umbrellas are used up.

q: 夏天我们太爱喝冰水了，一大壶冰水一下子就喝___了。
zh: 夏天我们太爱喝冰水了，一大壶冰水一下子就喝光了。
py: xià tiān wǒ men tài ài hē bīng shuǐ le yī dà hú bīng shuǐ yī xià zi jiù hē guāng le
en: We love iced water so much in summer that the whole jug was gone in no time.
why: 喝光 stresses that nothing is left in the jug. 住, 开 and 着 do not say the water is used up.

q: 他一路上都在咳嗽，同事让他吃片药压___，免得开会时影响大家。
zh: 他一路上都在咳嗽，同事让他吃片药压住，免得开会时影响大家。
py: tā yī lù shàng dōu zài ké sou tóng shì ràng tā chī piàn yào yā zhù miǎn de kāi huì shí yǐng xiǎng dà jiā
en: He coughed all the way, so his colleagues told him to take a pill to suppress it so that he wouldn't disturb everyone in the meeting.
why: 压住 means hold down and keep under control, which fits suppressing a cough. 压掉 and 压光 do not exist, and 压开 would mean pressing something open.

q: 跑步的时候他突然头晕，赶紧扶___旁边的树。
zh: 跑步的时候他突然头晕，赶紧扶住旁边的树。
py: pǎo bù de shí hòu tā tū rán tóu yūn gǎn jǐn fú zhù páng biān de shù
en: While running he suddenly felt dizzy and quickly grabbed hold of the tree beside him.
why: 扶住 means hold on to something so you stay steady. 走 means taken away, 掉 means got rid of, and 光 means none left.

q: 春天来了，天气暖和了，大家都把厚衣服脱___了。
zh: 春天来了，天气暖和了，大家都把厚衣服脱掉了。
py: chūn tiān lái le tiān qì nuǎn huo le dà jiā dōu bǎ hòu yī fu tuō diào le
en: Spring has come and it's warm, so everybody has taken off their heavy clothes.
why: 脱掉 means take off and be rid of. 住 and 着 do not describe removing clothes, and 走 would mean the clothes were carried away.

q: 太阳出来了，雾慢慢散___了。
zh: 太阳出来了，雾慢慢散开了。
py: tài yáng chū lái le wù màn màn sàn kāi le
en: The sun came out and the fog slowly cleared.
why: 散开 means spread apart and break up, which is what fog does. 住 would mean held in place, which is the opposite, and 着 and 走 do not fit 散.

q: 我把雨伞放___门后面了。
zh: 我把雨伞放在门后面了。
py: wǒ bǎ yǔ sǎn fàng zài mén hòu miàn le
en: I put the umbrella behind the door.
why: 放在 needs the place right after it: 放在门后面. 给 would need a person, 成 a new form, and 着 is not a result that takes a place.

q: 妈妈把感冒药递___我，让我快点吃。
zh: 妈妈把感冒药递给我，让我快点吃。
py: mā ma bǎ gǎn mào yào dì gěi wǒ ràng wǒ kuài diǎn chī
en: Mum handed me the cold medicine and told me to take it quickly.
why: 递给 hands something over to a person, and the receiver 我 follows. 在 needs a place, 成 needs a new form, and 住 would mean held in place.

q: 医生把这张药方写___了中文，我才看得懂。
zh: 医生把这张药方写成了中文，我才看得懂。
py: yī shēng bǎ zhè zhāng yào fāng xiě chéng le zhōng wén wǒ cái kàn de dǒng
en: The doctor wrote the prescription in Chinese, so I could read it.
why: 写成了中文 says the prescription ended up in Chinese form. 给 would need a person, 在 would need a place after it, and 走 does not fit.

q: 冬天的雪很厚，孩子们把雪堆___了一座小山。
zh: 冬天的雪很厚，孩子们把雪堆成了一座小山。
py: dōng tiān de xuě hěn hòu hái zi men bǎ xuě duī chéng le yī zuò xiǎo shān
en: The winter snow was thick, and the children piled it up into a small hill.
why: 堆成 says the snow turned into a new shape, a small hill. 给 would need a person, and 在 and 到 would need a place, not a result form.

q: 请你把今天的天气预报转告___每一位同学，明天可能有大雨。
zh: 请你把今天的天气预报转告给每一位同学，明天可能有大雨。
py: qǐng nǐ bǎ jīn tiān de tiān qì yù bào zhuǎn gào gěi měi yī wèi tóng xué míng tiān kě néng yǒu dà yǔ
en: Please pass today's weather forecast on to every student; there may be heavy rain tomorrow.
why: 转告给 passes information to a person, with the receivers 每一位同学 right after it. 在 needs a place and 成 needs a new form.

q: 他把每次的检查结果都登记___一个小本子上，方便下次看病。
zh: 他把每次的检查结果都登记在一个小本子上，方便下次看病。
py: tā bǎ měi cì de jiǎn chá jié guǒ dōu dēng jì zài yī gè xiǎo běn zi shàng fāng biàn xià cì kàn bìng
en: He records every set of test results in a little notebook so it is handy for his next doctor visit.
why: 登记在…上 puts the record on a place, the notebook. 给 would need a person, 成 would need a new form, and 住 would mean held in place.

q: 夏天太热，爸爸把西瓜切___八块，大家一起吃。
zh: 夏天太热，爸爸把西瓜切成八块，大家一起吃。
py: xià tiān tài rè bà ba bǎ xī gua qiè chéng bā kuài dà jiā yì qǐ chī
en: It was so hot in summer that Dad cut the watermelon into eight pieces for everyone to share.
why: 切成八块 says the watermelon turned into eight pieces. 给 would need a person and 在 would need a place after it.

q: 医生让他把这些药分___三次吃。
zh: 医生让他把这些药分成三次吃。
py: yī shēng ràng tā bǎ zhè xiē yào fēn chéng sān cì chī
en: The doctor told him to split this medicine into three doses.
why: 分成三次 divides the medicine into three portions. 给 would need a receiver, and 在 and 到 would need a place, not a number of portions.

q: 昨天雾太大了，我们都___看见山。
zh: 昨天雾太大了，我们都没看见山。
py: zuó tiān wù tài dà le wǒ men dōu méi kàn jiàn shān
en: It was so foggy yesterday that none of us saw the mountain.
why: 昨天 marks one past occasion, so the result 看见 is negated with 没. 不 would be a refusal or a habit, 别 is a command, and 会 is not a negative.

q: 今天的天气预报我___看完，不知道明天下不下雨。
zh: 今天的天气预报我还没看完，不知道明天下不下雨。
py: jīn tiān de tiān qì yù bào wǒ hái méi kàn wán bù zhī dào míng tiān xià bù xià yǔ
en: I haven't finished the weather forecast yet, so I don't know whether it will rain tomorrow.
why: 还没 says the result has not come about yet, and the sentence continues from that. 不看完 would be a refusal to finish, which does not fit the cue.

q: 他昨天___听清楚医生的话，所以今天又去了一次医院。
zh: 他昨天没听清楚医生的话，所以今天又去了一次医院。
py: tā zuó tiān méi tīng qīng chu yī shēng de huà suǒ yǐ jīn tiān yòu qù le yī cì yī yuàn
en: He didn't hear the doctor clearly yesterday, so he went to the hospital again today.
why: 昨天 makes it a past event, so 没 negates the result 听清楚 and there is no 了. 不听清楚 would be a refusal or a general habit.

q: 对不起，我___找到你的体检报告，明天再给你好吗？
zh: 对不起，我没找到你的体检报告，明天再给你好吗？
py: duì bù qǐ wǒ méi zhǎo dào nǐ de tǐ jiǎn bào gào míng tiān zài gěi nǐ hǎo ma
en: Sorry, I didn't find your medical report; may I give it to you tomorrow?
why: 没 negates 找到 because the search ended without a result. 不找到 is not a way to say could not find, and 别 is a command.

q: 虽然已经吃了三天药，但是他的药还___吃完，医生让他继续吃。
zh: 虽然已经吃了三天药，但是他的药还没吃完，医生让他继续吃。
py: suī rán yǐ jīng chī le sān tiān yào dàn shì tā de yào hái méi chī wán yī shēng ràng tā jì xù chī
en: Although he has taken the medicine for three days, he hasn't finished the course yet, and the doctor told him to keep taking it.
why: 还没吃完 says the course has not been finished yet. 还不吃完 is not natural, because with 还 the negation of a result that has not come about is 没.

q: 夏天的雨太大，我的伞___撑住，被风吹走了。
zh: 夏天的雨太大，我的伞没撑住，被风吹走了。
py: xià tiān de yǔ tài dà wǒ de sǎn méi chēng zhù bèi fēng chuī zǒu le
en: The summer rain was so heavy that my umbrella couldn't hold up and was blown away by the wind.
why: 伞没撑住 says that the holding result did not happen, and the next clause tells what followed. 不撑住 would be a refusal, which an umbrella cannot do.

q: 我洗___澡就去睡觉了。
zh: 我洗完澡就去睡觉了。
py: wǒ xǐ wán zǎo jiù qù shuì jiào le
en: I went to bed as soon as I'd had my shower.
why: 洗澡 is a verb-object word, so the result goes right after the verb part: 洗完澡. 洗着澡 would mean in the middle of it, and 会 and 到 do not fit.

q: 下___课，我们一起去医院看小王吧。
zh: 下完课，我们一起去医院看小王吧。
py: xià wán kè wǒ men yì qǐ qù yī yuàn kàn xiǎo wáng ba
en: Let's go to the hospital to visit Xiao Wang together after class finishes.
why: 下课 is a verb-object word and the result sits after 下: 下完课 means class has ended. 着 would mean class is still going on, and 会 and 见 do not fit.

q: 我刚才在抽屉里找到___两个体温计。
zh: 我刚才在抽屉里找到了两个体温计。
py: wǒ gāng cái zài chōu ti lǐ zhǎo dào le liǎng gè tǐ wēn jì
en: I just found two thermometers in the drawer.
why: 了 goes right after the result 找到 before a counted object. 过 would say you once found them, which 刚才 rules out, and 着 and 的 do not fit.

q: 我吃完___两片药，才觉得舒服一点。
zh: 我吃完了两片药，才觉得舒服一点。
py: wǒ chī wán le liǎng piàn yào cái jué de shū fu yì diǎn
en: I only felt a bit better after I'd taken the two tablets.
why: 了 follows the result 吃完 before the counted object 两片药. 着 and 的 do not fit a completed action, and 过 would say you had once done it.

q: 天气太热，他一口气喝完___整整一瓶冰水，结果肚子疼了。
zh: 天气太热，他一口气喝完了整整一瓶冰水，结果肚子疼了。
py: tiān qì tài rè tā yì kǒu qì hē wán le zhěng zhěng yī píng bīng shuǐ jié guǒ dǔ zi téng le
en: It was so hot that he drank a whole bottle of iced water in one go, and then his stomach hurt.
why: 了 goes after the result 喝完 and before the counted object. 着 and 的 do not fit a completed action, and 过 would turn it into past experience.

q: 风太大，晾在外面的衣服都被吹走___。
zh: 风太大，晾在外面的衣服都被吹走了。

en: The wind was so strong that the clothes hanging outside were all blown away.

q: 你的感冒药吃完___没有？

q: —你看完今天的天气预报了吗？—看完___。
